The '''Landor system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Thesme sector/Legends|Thesme sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was known to be overrun with [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] by [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]], and was a significant danger when travelling to [[Telos]].<ref name="JA2">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Dark Rival]]''</ref>
